decisions.reason: After four years, two years without visible market presence, and clear overlap in resin injection equipment, the option value of waiting appears largely exhausted relative to the benefit of reallocating resources.

Although technically close to the core spray portfolio, the lack of observed market visibility by 2020 to 2021 suggests weak standalone traction, so management would likely stop carrying it as a separate product.

A manual airless spray gun remains highly consistent with the firm’s established capabilities, customer base, and service structure, so keeping it open still has reasonable value despite mixed visibility signals.
As a multi-model line in a core application area, it likely retains the strongest option value and lowest relative continuation cost, making continued retention the more plausible choice.
